payload.core_mechanism_summary: Simulates day-by-day sock usage and purchase, decrementing socks and incrementing count, adding socks every m-th day until socks run out.
payload.rationale: The solution uses iterative simulation, which is a trivial exhaustive search over days. The rule suggested search_backtracking, though no backtracking occurs; chosen as it is the closest match from the provided complete_search subtypes.
